༄༅/ /legs sbyar klog tshul gyi bstan bcos blo gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtsha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /legs sbyar klog tshul gyi bstan bcos blo gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gsung gi dbang phyug la ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab gcig tu bsdus nas gdul bya'i snang ngor lha'i sku/ gzugs can 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can bdag ste 'jam dpal/ dang dbyer med yongs 'dzin rje/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal sa skya pa/ dbyangs mched dang mus pa'i chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can/ zhabs/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la gus btud nas/ /gsang sngags zab mo mtha' dag gi bzlas brjod byed pa'i gang zag la/ /med thabs blo la shin tu nges par/ med pa'i legs sbyar klog tshul gyi/ /bstan bcos ming ngam mtshan la/ blo gsal kun dga' zhes bya 'di/ /sangs rgyas kyi/ bstan dang 'gro deng sang sngags par rlom zhing gsang sngags bzla mi shes pa'i/ la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir lugs 'di'i tshad ma'i skye bur gyur pa/ dpang lo chen po blo gros brtan pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa/ tshogs gsum ming tshig yi ge gsum du/ gsal ba ste gnas pa/ las 'dir/ yi ge'i skabs su sngags kyi/ sgra klog pa'i tshul gsungs pa bzhin 'dir bshad par bya ste/ ka sde spyir 'byung chen nam mkha'o/ / ka sa/ kha chu/ ga me/ gha rlung / nga / bye brag tu nam mkha'/ /tsa sde rlung tsa sa/ chu/ tsha dza me/ dzha rlung / nya nam mkha' 'o/ /sa ṭa ṭa sde me/ tha chu/ ḍa me/ ḍha rlung / ṇa nam mkha' 'o/ /ta sde sa/ ta sa/ tha chu/ da me/ dha/ rlung / na/ nam mkha' 'o/ /pa sde chu/ pa sa/ pha chu/ba me/

bha rlung / ma/ nam mkha'o/ /sde pa lnga'o/ /ya rlung yig ra me/ la sa/ wa chu/ stod smad du 'byung zhing dbus su mi 'byung bas/ mthar gnas bzhi'o/ /sha rlung / ṣa me/ sa sa/ ha nam mkha'/ dro ba brjod dus kha nang du rlung dro chil ba 'byung bas/ bzhi 'o/ /a ā/ nam mkha'i yi ge gnyis/ i ī/ rlung gi gnyis/ u ū/ chu'i gnyis/ ṛ ṝ/ me'i gnyis/ l̥ l̥̄/ sa'i gnyis/ e aḥ ye shes kyi yi ge gnyis so/ /dbyangs bcu gnyis so/ /e rlung yig gnyis/ ā+ai/ o ā+au/ chu yig gnyis/ mtshams sbyor bzhi'o/ / dbyangs yig bcu drug g+pa chu/ k+pha klog dus mchu sbyor bas/ mchu can no/ /ྈka nam mkha'i yi ge klog dus lce rtsa can nas 'byung bas/ lce rtsa can no/ /lce rtsa can dang mchu can ni/ a lce rtsa can ni/ ka a kha/ a mchu can ni/ pa a ba/ zhes par bklag go /gsal byed srog med sde pa'i bar na tsheg med pa'i/ phyi ma'i mgor/ /brtsegs yi ge gzhan/ pa'am ma brtsegs pa'i/ tsheg med kyang / yar la sbyar/ / te dper na/ pad+ma/ pad ma/ rak+ṣa rag khya/ tad tsha/ tats+tsha/ lta bu rnams brtsegs pa/ yar sbyar ro/ /pad ma/ ad ma ko lta bu rnams ma brtsegs pa'i/ tsheg med do/ /brjod lhan cig tu/ du mi rung pa/ mang po/ dang nyung / du/ brtsegs pa rnams ni yi ge rang / rang gi sgra dran pa ste thon/ tsam bklag du/ de yang / phral nas/ bklag pa'i dus su/ dbyangs te na ro gug 'breng klad kor rnams/ ni yi ge 'og ma'i dbang / / te 'og ma la sbyar ro/ /de yang / phyogs gcig tu brjod du mi rung ba mang po/ brtsegs dper na/ hak+ṣamalawaraya lta bu dang /

k+ṣaṃmayu lta bu dang / nyung ba phyogs gcig tu brjod du mi rung ba/ dper na/ k+tharo ka tha ro/ lta bu'o/ /de la dbyangs 'og ma'i dbang du gyur pas/ 'og na 'dug pa de la mgor na ro gug 'greng klad kor te/ rgyan dang / zhabs zhabs kyu ya ta ra ta rnams/ /rgyan sbyin no/ /sha dang / ṣa gnyis yi ge 'og ma la/ yar sbyar dus/ sa dang sbyar ba/ mthun/ te dper na/ gaṣ+ṇa 'gas ṇa/ bhishata bhis ta/ tiṣatha tis tha lta bu rnams so/ /yang / nya dang / na gnyis yi ge gong ma la/ yar sbyar dus/ na ltar bklag ste dper na/ pañtsa pan tsa/ kaṇ+ḍa la kaṇa ḍa lta bu rnams so/ /la/ /gzhan sbyar phal cher bod dang mthun/ / ste dper na/ karma/ tad+ya thā lta bu'o/ /sde pa'i lnga/ dang po gang yin de/ srog med de yi ge gong ma dang bar na tsheg med na/ tsa/ /bod kyi ga sogs bzhin ste sde pa lnga'i gsum gsum pa/ yar sbyar/ / te dper na/ thak+ku ra/ thag ku/ tats+tsha/ tad tsha/ kod ḍa koṭ+ṭa pi/ /gup+tiṃ/ grub ting / tsit+ta tsid ta/ lta bu dang / badz+ra 'ba' dzar/ lta bu'o/ /ṣa log la yi ge gzhan/ btags pa pa rnams ni sa la btags/'i gdangs lta bu/ shig tu klog la/ de yang tiṣ+ṭha/ tis tha ṣ+ṭha/ s+d+ya/ dza la nya btags pa rnams ni yang na/ 'gya yang na/ star bklag / ste ma ga ta pa rnams 'gya ru 'bod la/ kha che ba rnams snya ru 'bod pa'i phyir ro/ /dz+nyā na/ ra ta phal cher bod dang 'dra/ / ste de yang dper na/ kra ma gri ha/ bra ma/ tra pa s+ya/ lta bu rnams so/ /ra de bar na tsheg med cing / la gnyis btags pa'i rigs rnams/ ra yi ge gong ma la/ yar sbyar/ / te de yang dper na/ ar+ya/ ar ya/ bir+ya/ bir ya/ dharmā dhar ma/

sarba/ sar ba lta bu'o/ /ka da/ kha la/ ya ta byung na/ bod dang klog lugs/ 'dra/ / ste de yang dper na/ shākya/ sam khya/ lta bu'o/ /ya ta yi ge gang la byung yang / 'greng bu ra 'gro ste/ ring cha med/ / la thung ngur klog wa sta ste zur gsum yi ge gang la byung yang / ra 'gro ste/ na ro ring cha med/ / pa thung ngur klog de 'ang dper na/ h+ya ba he/ bh+ya/ bhe/ bya/ be/ shwa ra/ sho dwa do/ ba/ kwa ko kha/ ḍ+wa ḍo/ zhes pa lta bu rnams te 'di rnams ni smad de stod pa'i yi ge zhes bya'o/ /'greng bu can dang na ro can/ /ring cha can rnams ni yi ge gnyis brjod pa'i/ yun tsam du cung ring par/ bklag /shin tu ring cha can dang na ro can dang 'greng bu yod pa dang yi ge ngo bo gnyis gnyis brtsegs pa rnams ni/ ring po gsum yun tsam du klog go /de yang 'greng bu ring cha can/ sogs/ /ke ta/ na mo/ ā kar sha dā na/ lta bu rnams so/ /shin tu ring po/ ni/ de bany+nya bin ny+nya/ ta/ ra dz+dzany+nya dzan ny+nya/ su tra/ lta bu'o/ /ming gcig ston pa'i/ thog mar/ sde pa lnga/ 'i gsum pa rnams/ / byung na/ 'a yis 'phul ba lta bur bklag go /ming gcig ston pa'i/ dbus dang mthar gnas pa'i gsum pa rnams/ bod dang mtshungs/ / te/ de yang / sde pa'i gsum pa/ ni ga sde'i gsum pa/ ga tsa sde'i/ dza/ ṭa sde'i/ ḍa ta sde'i/ da/ pa sde'i/ ba rnams so/ /de rnams/ ming gi thog mar byung na/ 'ag 'dza 'dra 'ad 'ab lta bu 'as 'phul ba ltar bklag ste/ dper na/ gi ga 'ga'/ 'dza'/ dza ya/ ḍa 'dra'/ ma ru/ 'ba'/ ba ra kri badz+ra/ 'ba' dzar/ de ba de ba/ lta bu'o/ /ming gi dbus dang tha mar byung na bod bzhin bklag go

/dper na/ yo ga ni/ ra dza na/ paṇa ḍa ba/ ka ba rtsa lta bu ming gcig ston pa'i/ dbus su byung na/ bod bzhin bklag go /ra ga bhar dza/ paṇe ḍa/ swa bha ba/ ta tha ga tha/ lta bu ming gcig ston pa'i/ tha mar gnas pa rnams kyang / bod bzhin bklag go /'di ma shes par ga thams cad 'gar bklag pa sogs mun par 'khyams pa phyin ci log tu klog pa shin tu/ mang ngo / /sde pa gsum pa'i ṭa sde'i/ dang po 'i yi ge /bzhi/ /ta sde 'i dang po bzhi la/ ra btags pa dang / cha mthun te/ /lce rtse cung zad steng bkug bklag /sha yang de bzhin sha la ra btags pa/ dang 'dra ba ste/ /k+ṣa ni ka la sha btags pa/ khya kha la ya ta btags pa/ dang cha mthun der/ bklag /de yang sde pa gsum pa'i dang po bzhi/ ṭa ṭha ṇa ḍha rnams ni/ ta sde la ra btags pa/ tra thra dra dh+ra/ rnams dang / 'dra ba las lce rtse steng du cung zad bskyod pa'o/ /ṣa yang gong du brjod pa bzhin/ shra cung 'dra ba las/ lce/ rtse steng du bskyod pa'o/ /k+ṣa yang gong gi mchan bzhin/ khya ru bklag go /sde pa lnga'i/ bzhi pa bzhi pa/ rnams ni gsum pa/ gsum pa la/ /ha sgra cung zad ldan par bya/ /de yang sde pa lnga'i bzhi pa ni/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams yin la 'di rnams klog dus/ 'thug po 'i yi ge yin pas/ dbyangs te ha'i sgra cung zad/ che bar bklag go /rjes su nga ro ste klad kor ni/ sde pa lnga/ la/ /rang rang gi sde pa'i lnga par bklag /ya sogs mthar gnas bzhi dro ba bzhi ste/ brgyad la nga ru'o/ /rjes su nga ro ni/ sde pa lnga'i nang du rang gi sde pa'i lnga pa lnga par bklag ste/ kam̐ ka pa/ ga ni/ gam̐ gang / ga kham̐ khang / ku/ pam̐ pang / ka /mam̐ mang / ga /ka sde'o/ /tsam̐ tsan/ tshur+ṇa/ tsham̐ tshan/ dza/ pam̐ pan/ dza/

tsa sde'o/ /ṭam̐ ṭan/ ṭham̐ wan/ ḍam̐ ḍan/ ḍham̐ ḍhan/ ṇam̐/ ṇan/ na rnams ni rjes su nga ro 'o/ /ru'o/ /pam̐ pam pham̐ pham/ bam̐ bam/ bham̐ bham/ mam̐ mam/ ma ru'o/ /de yang yi ge 'og ma'i dbang yin pas rjes su nga ro yod pa'i yi ge de'i/ gral 'og na gang snang ba de'i sde tshan dang mthun par lnga pa lnga pa yang / bklag cing / shad kyi bshad pa dang tsheg gnyis kyis bcad pa/ la ni yi ge de rang gi sde pa'i lnga/ par bklag go de yang / ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ mthar gnas bzhi dang / dro ba bzhi ste brgyad po de la rjes su nga ro mthong na nga ru'o/ / 'di lta ste/ yam̐ yang / ram̐ rang / lam̐ lang / wam̐/ wang / sham̐ ṣam̐ sam̐ ham̐/ a sogs dbyangs bcu drug kyang rung ngo / / de yang / am̐ iṃ um̐ ang ing ung / sogs/ pa lta bu rnams so/ /tsheg drag gam rnam bcad ces kyang bya ste thig le gnyis kyi/ can de 'dra ni/ drag por te sa'i sgra dang bcas pa/ bklags te de yang / na maḥ mas/ tad thaḥ thas/ tiṣ+ṭha ṣ+ṭhas/ ai e i/ au o u zhes pa dag ni/ dag ni/ e o zhes pa'i/ dag thung pa dag la/ i e la dang / us o la/ brgyan par bklag pa ste de yang / ai zhes pa ni/ e/ i zhes bklag au o zhes pa ni/ u/ zhes bklag zhes pa ste de bzhin du/ kai ki'i/ kau ko'u/ bhai ra/ bhe'i/ rau ro'u/ ces pa ltar klog pa ste 'di 'dra rnams 'greng ste bkug pa'i yi ge dang bstod de dmad pa'i yi ge zhes zer ro/ /gnyis/ /ke'u ro gnyis gsal byed yi ge gcig pa ste/ ka gcig la gnyis brtsegs pa lta bu la/ sogs/ pa yi ge gnyis gnyis/ brtsegs pa mthon par te shin tu ring por/

bklag par bya/ ste de yang / k+ka/ s+sa/ t+ta/ thatha/ d+dha/ lta bu rnams so/ /de dag ni dpang lo chen pos gsung rab tshogs gsum gsal ba'i yi ge'i skabs su sgra klog tshul gsungs pa'i dkyus gzhung la lo chen byang chub rtse mos mchan bu'i 'grel pa mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ slar yang de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i dgra grogs rtsi tshul sogs kyi legs bshad cung zad brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar yi ge'i ngo bo gang / /gang gis bsdus shing skye ba'i tshul/ /de yi klog thabs ci zhe na/ /ngo bo a l̥ ka l̥ ste/ / dbyangs gsal gnyis kyi gsal byed la sde pa yin min gnyis yod pa'i sde pa min pa'i gsal byed kyi yi ge ni/ nu ma zung gi rnam pa can rnam bcad dang / ḍa ma ru'i rnam pa can lce rtsa can dang / glang po'i myos bum gyi rnam pa can dang / thig le'i rnam pa can rjes su nga ro rnams so/ /pho mo ma ning gsum de la pho'i yi ge ni/ nga nya na ma ma lnga ma gtogs pa gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams yin la/ mo'i yi ge ni/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ bzhi ma gtogs pa'i dbyangs rnams yin la/ ma ning gi yi ge ni/ nga nya ṇa na ma lnga dang / ṛ ṝ li li bzhi ste dgu po rnams yin no/ /gzhan yang dang kyog dang shad la rkyen gyi yi ge gu gu/ zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ na ro ste bzhi la yan lag gi yi ge tsheg la srog gi yi ge zhes slob dpon rtse mo'i byis pa bde 'jug pa las gsungs so/ /du gnas/ /a ā gnyis dang / ku ha thaka kus mtshon te ka kha ga gha nga dang ha dang thaka dang dgu ni/ nam mkha'i khams/ /mgrin pa'i gnas las byung ba yin/ /i ī gnyis dang / tsus mtshon te tsa tsha dza dzha nya dang ya dang sha dang dgu ni/ tsu ya sha rlung gi khams/ /lce rtse so rkan dag las 'byung / /u ū gnyis dang / su sus mtshon te pa pha ba bha ma dang wa g+pa gnyis dang dgu ni/ wa g+pa chu yi khams/

/mchu yi gnas las 'byung ba yin/ /ṛ ṛ ṭus mtshon pa'i ṛ ṝ dang ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa dang ra dang ṣa dang dgu ni/ ṭu ra ṣa me yi khams/ /spyi bo'i gnas las 'byung ba yin/ /l̥ tu la sa sa yi khams/ /lce rtse so las 'byung ba yin/ / de dag ni 'byung chen gyi sde'o/ /'byung ba chung pa sde lnga yang / /ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams sa/ /kha sogs chu yin ga sogs me/ /gha sogs rlung yin nga sogs mkha'/ /oṃ gsang sngags gang la yang / dang na mo tad+ya thā/ /spangs pa'i ming dper na oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhi lta bu la oṃ dor ba'i a de nyid brtsi bar bya ba yin la/ gi thog ma dang / /sgrub pa po/ rang gi ming gi thog ma ngag dbang sogs kyi nga sogs gang yin pa de rang gi thog ma'i yi ger/ gzung bar bya/ /gsal byed brtsegs pa ste rang gi ming la rgyal mtshan dpal lta bu la ra nyid thog ma'i yi ger gzung bar bya zhing / sam 'phul bzhag yod/ / pa ste bsod nams lta bu la ba nyid thog ma'i yi ger bzung zhing / 'phul brtsegs med pa rnams la ni thog ma'i yi ge gang yin pa de gzung ngo / /dang po'i yi ge sbyar bar bya/ /gsal byed ka kha sogs yi dam gyi sngags kyi thog ma la yod pa'i gsal byed kyi yi ge de rang gi ming gi yi ge'i thog ma'i/ dgra gyur na sgrub pa po la/ nad mang zhing / /dbyangs yig a ā sogs yi dam gyi snying po'i sngags kyi thog ma la yod pa'i dbyangs kyi yi ge de rang gi ming gi thog ma'i yi ge'i/ dgrar gyur na sgrub pa po/ srog dang bral/ / de'i rgyu mtshan gsal byed lus dang dbyangs yig srog tu brda sprod pa rnams kyis bshad pas so/ /de phyir dgra grogs brtsi ba gces/ /sa yig ni/ dgra me yig yin la/ me yig gi dgra chu/ / yig go /chu yig gi dgra rlung yig yin la/

rlung yig gi dgra sa/ / yig go /sa yig ni me yig la nus med de/ /me yig ni chu yig la nus pa med/ /chu yig ni rlung yig la nus med de/ /rlung yig ni sa yig la nus pa med/ /sa yig dang / chu yig gnyis/ phan tshun grogs po ste/ /me yig dang / rlung yig kyang / phan tshun grogs pa yin/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i yi ge ni 'byung bzhi'i yi ge kun gyi grogs yin te/ /'byung bzhi'i yi ge kun kyang nam mkha'i yi ge'i grogs su 'gyur/ / bar bshad do/ /dgra grogs gang yang ma yin par nus med du gyur na/ dgos don gang yin kyang 'bras bu med pas mi 'grub la/ grogs su gyur na gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sngags kyi dgra grogs brtsi tshul sogs mdo tsam bshad pa de dag ni snar thang lo tsā ba sam̐ gha shrīs mdzad pa'i sngags kyi klog thabs bsdus pa'i gzhung la/ de'i ṭik+ka mthong ba don gsal nas 'byung ba'i go don gal che ba rnams mchan bur btab pa yin pas kho bo'i rang bzo ma yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ deng sang dus kyi sngags par rlom pa rnams/ /kun slong bza' btung kho na don gnyer bas/ /lha bsgrub cho ga 'ga' re 'dzin srid kyang / /ting 'dzin lta ci sngags kyang log par bzla/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus kyi sngags 'chang rnams/ /sgrub dkyil bshar sbyangs 'don pa goms pas na/ /kha g.yeng mig g.yeng sgo nas chags sdang gi /nyon mongs 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'i 'du 'tshogs kyis/ /bya brel mang bas dkor zas dkor chu rnams/ /ri dang mtsho ltar bsags nas dud 'gro bzhin/ /'chi ba mthong tshe dal 'byor stong log tu/ /byed pa'i chos gzugs rnams la bsam bzhin khrel/ /de phyir kho bo'i rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams/ /tshur spyon gsang sngags zab mo'i smin grol gyi/ snga nas dang /

yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyi spyi gzugs mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin bslu med chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du bkod pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos khyi lo zla ba dang po'i dmar cha dge ba gsum pa'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ 'byung ba'i gnas su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i shākya'i dge slong rig sngags 'chang ba rnam dpyod kyi mig rab tu gsal ba'i rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos dad gus kyi sgo nas bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ //kal+yā na war+dhan+tu// //gcig zhus lags// ༈ mkhan chen/chos tshul kun la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnal 'byor la/ /rtse gcig gzhol bas rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /rgya cher bsgrub cing de dag thams cad kyang / /spros bral zung 'jug lta bas rgyas btab cing / /'khor gsum yongs dag bsngo bas zin pa gces/ /'dir bshad legs sbyar klog tshul bstan bcos 'di/ /gsang sngags rab 'byams bsgrub la smos ci dgos/ /bzlas brjod phra mo bgyid pa'i gang zag la'ang / /med thabs med phyir kun gyis gces par zungs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces legs sbyar klog tshul gyi bstan bcos blo gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba 'di yang / grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhal a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
